picks.title: HAIARA Power Banks Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold on Amazon.com by Mitrytech
picks.remedyText: Consumers should stop using the recalled power banks immediately. Consumers who purchased their power banks on Amazon.com from Mitrytech should contact Mitrytech for instructions on how to receive a full refund. To receive a refund, consumers will be required to submit a photo of their recalled power bank with the word “recalled” written on it in permanent marker and confirm disposal of the power bank in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
picks.consumerContact: Email at HAIARArecall@outlook.com or online at www.haiara.net/recalls.html or www.haiara.net and click on “Recalls” for more information.

steps: Write recalled on the power bank in permanent marker.
Take a photo of the power bank showing the writing.
Email the photo to Mitrytech at HAIARArecall@outlook.com.
Dispose of the power bank following local laws.

explanation.plain: Stop using the power bank. Write recalled on it in permanent marker, send a photo, and throw it away safely to get your money back.
explanation.technical: "submit a photo of their recalled power bank with the word recalled written on it in permanent marker" sets photo_required, write_recalled, marker_text (case kept as given) and must_show; "full refund" sets remedy with no fixed amount. No channel is named for the photo, so the first consumer contact (email) is used. Disposal comes after the photo and is not an action.

picks.why: A 2026 power bank recall (Oct 29, 2026) whose remedy pays a full refund for a photo of the power bank with the word "recalled" written on it in permanent marker. The photo needs only the marked product, so a retake for a missing marking is easy to show. Three official images of model W5 PRO (front and side).

picks.title: Guang Zhou Recalls Wantefully Hair Dryer Brushes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Electrocution, Shock and Burn Hazards; Violate Federal Regulations
picks.firm: Guang Zhou Shi Wan Te Fu Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si, dba Wantefully, of China
picks.remedyText: Consumers should unplug and stop using the recalled hair dryers immediately and contact Guang Zhou to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the power cord and provide a photo of the destroyed product to wantefully@163.com.

picks.why: The remedy asks the owner to cut the power cord and email a photo of the destroyed product for a full refund. A hair dryer brush is a small appliance that is easy to photograph with its cord cut. Five official images, including the packaging label with the model number, which also gives the official-image preset a clear picture to test the own-photo check.

picks.title: Fashion Brand Apparel Recalls QZH.DUAO Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear
picks.remedyText: Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama sets immediately and contact Fashion Brand Apparel for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pajamas in half and email a photo of the destroyed pajama set to qzh.duaoproductrecall@outlook.com to receive the refund. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.
